title: New Gender, Old School? Geschlecht im Kontext Schule
summary: How are intersectional gender relations reproduced and transformed in teaching, teacher training and educational materials? The authors examine the debate on the change and persistence of pluralised and intersectional sexuality and gender orders. They focus on the tension between the reproduction, disruption and transformation of heteronormativity in the school context and on how educational gender studies can support negotiation processes in school pedagogy, professional research and subject didactics.
